_comment: Machine-readable methodology. The scorer reads this file; the public
methodology page renders the same numbers from
frontend/src/lib/fixtures/methodology.ts. The version string must match in
both places — if they drift, the site is publishing a method it does not use.
Becomes a row in the `methodologies` table (weights as jsonb) once Supabase
is live, at which point this file goes away and drift becomes impossible.

south-korea.why: Korean firms publish revenue but not headcount, and raw revenue only measures size: Lee & Ko leads on turnover while Yulchon, Yoon & Yang and Bae Kim & Lee lead on revenue per lawyer. Dividing by professional count is what makes the figure comparable between a 1,200-lawyer firm and a 90-lawyer one.
south-korea.underlyingSource: Revenue originates in the VAT taxable-base declarations (부가가치세 과세표준 신고액) firms file with the National Tax Service (국세청). That filing is the authority; it is not the Ministry of Justice.
south-korea.whatWeUse: Only figures a firm has itself published, and official open data. The per-firm league table compiled by 법률신문 is not used: that publication already sits on our excluded source list, and its table is a compilation in the same way a Chambers band table is.
